parts:
Hi all, I could not fit the (multilevel) model, kept getting the message, "Error in as.list(LIST) : object 'LIST' not found". Please advise !!!

library(lavaan)

model <- '
level: 1
y1 ˜ x1
level: 2
y1 ˜ w1
'
fit <- sem(model,
data = Demo.twolevel,
cluster = "cluster")
